98060307.s: Enjoy greenery, trees and relaxation in the beautiful natural setting of Tilal Park. Open 24 hours.
98060307.b: Tilal Park is a place to enjoy greenery and trees and to relax amid beautiful surroundings. It has a small lake and a wooden walkway that winds around a pine forest. Known for its high standard of cleanliness and good organization, it offers shaded areas, clean restrooms and safe areas for families, making it one of the most popular parks in north Riyadh.

98060306.s: A park of striking beauty, with flowers and roses of many colors arranged attractively along the path. Open 24 hours.
98060306.b: Flower Park is known for its striking beauty, with flowers and roses of many colors arranged attractively along the walkway. It is regarded as the best walking trail in Riyadh, especially in winter, and has simple fitness equipment for bodyweight exercises as well as misting fans to ease the summer heat.

98060305.s: One of the best-known parks, with many facilities and services for a memorable outing for families and individuals. Open 24 hours.
98060305.b: Al Nakheel Park is one of the best-known parks, full of facilities and services that make for a memorable outing for families and individuals. It has a skating track, a long walking path and a separate cycling path, along with football and basketball courts. It is very busy on weekends and is one of the largest modern parks in the Al Nakheel district.

98060303.s: One of the best parks for spending quality time with family or on your own. Open 24 hours.
98060303.b: Al Hamra Park is considered one of the best parks for spending quality time with family or on your own, and it is enclosed by a wall that adds extra security. It is spacious and green, with security guards and a cleaning crew, as well as friendly cats roaming the grounds, which makes it suitable for walking and light exercise.

98060302.s: A refuge for families and individuals, offering a calm, peaceful atmosphere and a chance to enjoy activities. Open 24 hours.
98060302.b: King Fahd Park is a refuge for families and individuals, offering visitors a calm and peaceful atmosphere and the chance to enjoy activities amid wide green spaces on King Fahd Road. The park has a central seating area that draws a lively crowd in the evening, and organized walking paths around the whole park, making it better suited to evening strolls than to family picnics.

98060301.s: Home to beautiful natural scenery for outings with family and friends, with unique designs. Open 24 hours.
98060301.b: Al Khuzama Park is a green oasis hidden within the Diplomatic Quarter. It has shady trees and palms, winding maze-like paths, attractive water fountains and natural rocks along its edges. It offers a wonderful view over Wadi Hanifah and connects to a long walking trail that runs along the valley, making it a quiet destination that is ideal for contemplation and evening walks.
98060301.a: Al Khawabi Street, Al Safarat, Riyadh 12513

98060290.s: Samhaniya complex has a modern take on a traditional character, with a group of popular restaurants and cafes for a different and distinctive experience. A restaurant and cafe complex.
98060290.b: Samhaniya complex has a modern take on a traditional character and houses a group of popular restaurants and cafes for a different and distinctive experience in the heart of historic Diriyah. It also has shops selling rare items and antiques (qarashee), and is a great place to spend a warm winter evening around the fireplaces. Open until late at night.

98060288.s: Known for its luxury restaurant views and 21 unique international and local dining experiences. A restaurant and cafe complex. Open 8:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98060288.b: Al Mamlaka Social Dining is known for the views from its luxury restaurants and for 21 unique international and local dining experiences inside the famous Kingdom Centre. A nominal entry fee (about SAR 29) lets you wander between the different restaurants and choose dishes from any of them. It is very popular as a social destination that brings strangers together and turns them into friends. Open from 8:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98060288.a: Kingdom Centre, Olaya St, Al Olaya, Riyadh 12271

98060287.s: Brings together the best local and international restaurants and cafes to suit every taste. A restaurant and cafe complex. Open 24 hours.
98060287.b: Lumiere brings together the best local and international restaurants and cafes to suit every taste, from seafood to Lebanese, Italian and burgers. It has a bright design and upper balconies with lovely views, and small water channels that add a calm atmosphere. Open 24 hours.
98060287.a: Turki Bin Abdulaziz Al Awwal, Hittin, Riyadh 13513

98060285.s: Brings together the best local and international cafes and restaurants, and is conveniently located near the embassies. A restaurant and cafe complex. Open 8:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98060285.b: Little Riyadh brings together the best local and international cafes and restaurants, and is conveniently located near the embassies in the Diplomatic Quarter. It has branches of international chains such as Go & The Juice, and is known for its tasty pasta and steak dishes in a stylish modern setting that draws visitors, especially in the evening. Contact: 920024788. Open from 8:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.

98060284.s: Enjoy delicious international food and excellent coffee with a lovely view of an outdoor fountain. A restaurant and cafe complex.
98060284.b: Roshn Front is a modern destination near King Khalid International Airport, where you can enjoy delicious international food and excellent coffee with a lovely view of an outdoor fountain. It has well-known international restaurants such as Dave's Hot Chicken, and is an ideal stop for travelers or for residents of the north of the city.
98060284.a: Roshn Front, King Khalid International Airport, Riyadh

98060283.s: Enjoy a charming destination of brands, restaurants and cinemas in a modern style. A restaurant and cafe complex. Open 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98060283.b: The Esplanade is a charming destination that combines brands, restaurants and cinemas in a modern style. It is a complete entertainment center that is easy to get around. It has attractive night views and convenient parking, and is very popular as a family destination for evening outings before or after a movie. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98060283.a: Prince Turki Bin Abdulaziz Al Awal Rd, King Saud University, Riyadh 12371

98060263.s: Known for a wide variety of croffles alongside other delicious desserts. A cafe. Open 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98060263.b: Wasl Cafe is known for a wide variety of croffles alongside other delicious desserts, and is famous for its fresh waffles and distinctive hot chocolate. It serves creative drinks suited to cooler weather and has good reviews, despite some construction work around the site at times. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight (closed Monday to Wednesday).
98060263.a: Prince Yazid Ibn Abdullah Ibn Abdulrahman, Al Malqa, Riyadh 23567

98060262.s: Specializes in hot and cold Adeni tea, along with tasty sandwiches. A cafe. Open 6:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98060262.b: Adanya specializes in hot and cold Adeni tea, along with tasty sandwiches, and is known for its spicy tuna and halloumi with sahouq. It offers creative packaging and fast service, and overlooks Boulevard City, making it a practical stop for a break before or after exploring the area. Contact: 0555639986. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.

98060261.s: For lovers of art and coffee, serving coffee and delicious pastries along with art activities. A cafe. Open 7:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98060261.b: Cosefan is for lovers of art and coffee, serving coffee and delicious pastries along with art activities such as pottery and painting workshops. It has a green, plant-filled atmosphere and warm natural lighting, and is an ideal place to spend creative time with friends, away from traditional cafes. Contact: 0596200360. Open from 12:00 noon to 2:00 a.m.
98060261.a: Prince Abdullah Abdul Rahman, Al Diriyah Al Jadidah, Diriyah 13732

98060260.s: Known for serving the best beans from the homeland of Arabica, with an authentic taste for coffee lovers. A cafe. Open 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98060260.b: Jazean is known for serving the best beans from the homeland of Arabica, with an authentic taste for coffee lovers, and is in a prime location inside the Diplomatic Quarter. It is known for its spicy sandwich and halloumi with sahouq, and is especially appreciated for its local products and carefully packaged gifts that reflect Saudi hospitality. Contact: 920012063. Open from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.

98060258.s: For chocolate lovers, offering a wide range of chocolate treats alongside delicious pastries and coffee. A cafe. Open 6:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m.
98060258.b: Clay Coffee Boutique is for chocolate lovers, offering a wide range of treats alongside delicious pastries and coffee, and is known for its shakshuka croissant and brookie pudding. It is located inside King Khalid Airport in the Roshn Front area, with friendly service and reasonable prices for such a prime location. Contact: 0580030348. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 2:30 a.m.
98060258.a: Roshn Front - Shopping Area, King Khalid International Airport, Riyadh 13413

98060256.s: Offers a wide range of tasty pastries alongside coffee, in an atmosphere suited to work and study. A cafe. Open 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98060256.b: Meetup Cafe & Pastry offers a wide range of tasty pastries alongside coffee, in an atmosphere suited to work and study, and is known for its Ethiopian coffee and qatayef with sweet cream. It gives students a special discount, and its beautiful natural sunlight makes the place calm and relaxing. Contact: 0502947716. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.

98060255.s: Known for a wide variety of delicious desserts, with great seating across two floors. A cafe. Open 24 hours.
98060255.b: Trieste is known for a wide variety of delicious desserts, with great seating across two floors, and is famous for its cookies filled with liquid chocolate. It is open around the clock every day of the week. Reviews of the coffee quality are mixed, though there is general agreement that the desserts are excellent. Open 24 hours.

98060252.s: A quiet cafe serving excellent coffee, with an ideal atmosphere for work and study. A cafe. Open 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98060252.b: Coyard is a quiet cafe serving excellent coffee, with an ideal atmosphere for work and study, and is known for its pina colada and matcha, which have an authentic flavor without artificial sweetness. The baristas are friendly and patiently explain the products to new visitors. Contact: 0552645213. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

98060251.s: For all tastes, known for delicious coffee and hot chocolate in a calm atmosphere. A cafe. Open 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98060251.b: Carve Coffee Bar is for all tastes and is known for delicious coffee and hot chocolate in a calm atmosphere. It offers a choice of paper or ceramic cups, and is known for its mixed berry cheesecake and well-made flat white, although some visitors note that parking can be hard to find. Contact: 0505745780. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.

98060250.s: A modern, cheerful bakery with a wide selection of plant-based pastries alongside specialty coffee. A cafe. Open 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98060250.b: Kail Roastery is a modern, cheerful bakery with a wide selection of plant-based pastries alongside specialty coffee roasted on site. It has a bright interior and unconventionally shaped windows, and the outdoor seating has a lovely night view of Kingdom Tower. Contact: 0530668391. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98060250.a: Prince Sultan Bin Abdulaziz Al Amar St, Al Worood, Riyadh 12253

98060249.s: A cafe serving a variety of drinks and fresh pastries in a pleasant, friendly space. A cafe. Open 6:30 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98060249.b: Sohba is a cafe serving a variety of drinks and fresh pastries in a pleasant, friendly space, and is known for its honey cake and galaxy cake, along with a well-made latte. It is considered one of the best specialty coffee experiences in Riyadh, with comfortable decor suited to work and study. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98060249.a: Wadi Hajr St, Al Malqa, Riyadh 13252

98060248.s: A local cafe inspired by modern coffee shops, with several drive-through branches, open around the clock. A cafe. Open 24 hours.
98060248.b: Half Million is a local cafe inspired by modern coffee shops, with several drive-through branches, and it is open around the clock every day of the week. It is known for its matcha latte and collectible souvenir cups, which draw large crowds whenever a new design is released. Contact: 920014022. Open 24 hours.
98060248.a: Prince Muhammad Ibn Saad Ibn Abdulaziz Rd, Al Aqiq, Riyadh 13515

98060242.s: A bakery and cafe with a warm, homey atmosphere serving a tasty breakfast and distinctive desserts. A bakery. Open 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98060242.b: Home Bakery is a bakery and cafe with a warm, homey atmosphere serving a tasty breakfast and distinctive desserts, and is known for its Turkish simit, butter cake and mango flop. It has beautiful decor and large glass windows that give it a sense of luxury, with fast and friendly service even at busy times. Contact: 0533055568. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98060242.a: Anas Ibn Malik, Al Malqa, Riyadh 13524
